## Recording pill
- You can now drag the recording pill wherever you like, and it reopens there next time. It snaps to the center line, and dropping it back at its usual spot restores the default position. Dragging is paused while Read Aloud plays and while the quick-action card is open.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v9.01...v9.02
